title: ADscan PRO licence register export v1
description: The output of `adscan license register export` (JSON form): what one engine installation recorded under its PRO licence, for the quarterly reconciliation between a partner and ADscan. It never carries a domain name, a host, a user or a finding: a domain is its one-way per-partner domain code. entries is one row per domain code (registered rows carry the licence server's signed receipt, which verifies independently of the exporter; pending rows are a declaration). assessments is one usage line per assessment of a code: run_kind full_scan or recheck, the run, for a recheck the scan it re-checked, the identity band and the date. engagements is what those lines count as under the licence's retest window: a recheck never opens an engagement; a full scan inside the window of the engagement already open for its code is a retest of it; at or after the window's end it opens a new one. The licence server counts its own records with the same rule. Written by one writer (register_export in adscan_core/pro_license/client.py). Version marker: schema_version, '1.<minor>'; adscan_register is the legacy integer marker kept for readers of the first export. Declared objects may gain fields within a major; do not reject unknown keys. receipt and usage are opaque.

unattached_rechecks.$comment: Run ids of rechecks whose code has no engagement in this register (a workspace assessed before the licence was activated). Never billable.

usage.$comment: Offline engagement licences only: the environment ledger's usage for the licence term.

parent_run_id.$comment: For a recheck, the run id of the scan it re-checked; null for a full scan.

band.$comment: Identity band; pending until counted at the end of the scan.

retest_window_days.$comment: The licence window in force when a full scan ran; null for a recheck.

retest_until.$comment: First instant at which a full scan of the code opens a new engagement.
